verdict.rationale: Stripe's crypto offerings cover payments, onramp, payouts, and stablecoin financial accounts — but there is no evidence of a stablecoin issuance product (minting a branded coin, redemption mechanics, reserve management/attestation). This is a distinct product category (e.g., Bridge/Paxos-style issuance-as-a-service) that Stripe's evidence pack never mentions.
